_readme: Copy this file to your project root as demo.config.json and edit it.
Fields:
services[]  - everything the demo needs running. Order matters (dependencies first).
name        unique id, used for logs and the state file
command     executable to run (e.g. node, npx, dotnet, python, java)
startArgs   arguments for a production start
buildCommand optional; executable that runs the build (e.g. npx, npm)
buildArgs   optional; arguments for buildCommand, run before start when not in -DevMode
dir         working directory, relative to demo.config.json
port        local port it listens on
healthUrl   polled until it answers; the boot waits for this
expose      URL path prefixes the browser must reach on THIS service
default     true for the one service that serves everything else
managed     false to declare a service the skill must never start (e.g. a shared DB)
verifyPath  optional path probed through the public URL (defaults to healthUrl's path)
acceptStatus optional non-2xx codes that still mean 'reachable' (e.g. [401] for an auth-gated API)
note        optional string printed after a successful boot
devMode     optional { startArgs } used with --dev (or -DevMode on Windows)
gateway      the single local origin every browser request goes through
port        local port for the gateway (one tunnel targets this)
auth         optional; require a login before anyone reaches the app
enabled     true to turn on HTTP basic auth at the gateway
username    login name (default: demo)
passwordHash  bcrypt hash - preferred. Generate with scripts/gen-password.sh
password    plaintext alternative; hashed at boot and never written to disk
tunnel       optional; only relevant to the cloudflare/ngrok providers
token       named-tunnel token for a STABLE hostname across reboots
hostname    the hostname that token is routed to (e.g. demo.example.com)
notes[]      optional strings printed after a successful boot
notes: Without auth, anyone holding the link can open the demo. Run scripts/gen-password.sh to add a login.
